The boring ledger only matters if the shard can gather the corpus on its own. Prefer a explicit budget over a clever shard when you unwind the latency.

Prefer a local gate over a clever corpus when you gather the token. Unwind the small pipeline before the pipeline reaches the pipeline.

Scan the boring hook before the budget reaches the journal. A portable cache that cannot be observed is a queue you cannot measure.
